whoosh: Fast cinematic whoosh transition, air swipe, clean, no music
riser: Short reverse whoosh riser building into a hit, cinematic transition
pop: Bubbly playful UI pop sound for text appearing on screen
click: Crisp smartphone screen tap click, UI button press
kaching: Cash register ka-ching with coins, bright and satisfying
boom: Deep cinematic bass boom impact hit with short tail
horn: Philippine jeepney horn honking twice, beep beep, loud street horn
ding: Bright clean notification ding, positive chime
stamp: Heavy rubber stamp slam on paper, punchy thud
typing: Quick taps typing on a smartphone keyboard
engine: Diesel jeepney engine rumbling as it drives past on a city street, light traffic ambience
